text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: The Arima Kinen is finally here.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
As predicted, Narita Brian is competing.
The
morning news is calling this the
"sister showdown
of the century."

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Of course, the victor of said showdown
will
obviously be me.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Time for me to go. I have a promise to
keep with
Brian.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I can't even remember the last time we
raced each
other.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
You're strong now, Brian. You're the
strongest
Triple Crown Champion ever,
in fact. No wonder
they call you the
Beast.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
But if you're "the beast," what does that
make me
as your big sister?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I forged the path that brought you here
today.
Don't think for a second you're
leaving here with
the win.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: And catch me if you can!
